<translate>
'''Hellzone Grenade''' is Piccolo's trap technique. Instead of flying straight at the enemy, its ki blasts spread out to surround the target and then close in on it all at once.
</translate>

<translate>
== Learning it ==

[[Special:MyLanguage/Piccolo|Piccolo]] teaches Hellzone Grenade for '''6,000 TP'''. He has no alignment requirement. Like every ki technique, it needs [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Control|Ki Control]], an empty main hand and at least 5% Power Release, and it must be equipped in a technique slot.
</translate>

<translate>
== How it works ==

Hellzone Grenade is a '''Barrage''' ki attack: hold the slot key to charge it (2 seconds to reach 100%), keep holding to overcharge up to 175%, and release to fire.

It '''needs a target''': lock on ({{Key|Z}}) or aim at one. The ki blasts surround the target and then close in. Its damage is your Ki Damage × 2.5 × the charge.
</translate>

<translate>
== Upgrades ==

As a Barrage attack, it gains experience when it hits and can upgrade its damage, speed and cooldown. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Techniques|Techniques]].
</translate>
